_comment: Per-finding Aegis suppressions. The key is pattern:file:content-digest and deliberately omits the line number, so an entry survives every edit that does not touch the matched content. A finding is only listed here after it has been verified to be a false positive; see docs/decisions/0070-aegis-gate-suppression.md.

entries.note: The GitForge API row names the credential file that holds the bearer token. The row describes the credential's location; it contains no token.
A glyph-position golden value (27.345314025878906). Its 15-digit run matches the Amex shape; it is a float literal, not a card number.
Same float literal as the Amex entry above — the generic rule sees the same digit run.
The 'entity expansion' fixture. The test asserts that the SVG importer refuses an external entity, so the payload must name one.
Same deliberate fixture, seen by the hardening rule.
The Apple plist doctype ('PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN"'). The rule matches the quoted public identifier; the plist declares no entity.
Same Apple plist doctype, seen by the hardening rule.
A comment quoting a V8 crash dump observed in CI ('Stacktrace: ptr1=...'). It is documentation of a failure, not a stack trace the build prints.
